title: FounderGate Checker Report
description: A single verdict emitted by ONE checker in a bounded checker swarm. A checker is a read-only reviewer that inspects one (target, dimension) and reports what it found. A report is evidence, never an authorization: it can never green a lane by itself — the swarm coordinator only dedupes and aggregates reports for a founder / Terminal-0 sheriff to act on. A single checker NEVER emits the coordinator-derived verdicts 'CONFLICT' or 'HELD'; those are produced only by aggregation across reports.

schema_version.description: Semantic version of this report schema the emitter targeted.

checker_id.description: Stable identifier of the checker that produced this report. Unique within a queue.

target.description: What was checked (e.g. a lane id, a file glob, an artifact ref). Deduplication groups reports by (target, dimension).

dimension.description: The axis of the check (e.g. lease, safety, syntax, evidence). Two reports on the same (target, dimension) that disagree escalate to CONFLICT in aggregation.

verdict.description: The single outcome this one checker found. A raw checker may NOT emit 'CONFLICT' or 'HELD' — those are aggregation-only.

loop.description: Which coordinator loop produced this report. The coordinator runs at most 2 loops, so a report may never claim a loop above 2.

evidence_ref.description: Pointer to the machine evidence backing this verdict (a path, a log id, a fixture ref). Never inline secrets.

describes_only.description: Honesty invariant. A checker report DESCRIBES a finding; it never enforces or authorizes. Must be true.
